from app.database import db

class Problem(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'problems'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    title = db.Column(db.String(255), nullable=False)
    description = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    difficulty = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    created_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now())
    updated_at = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, server_default=db.func.now(), onupdate=db.func.now())

    def __repr__(self):
        return f"<Problem {self.id}: {self.title}>"
files.purpose: Define the Problem model for storing problem data.

from app.database import db

class Solution(db.Model):
    __tablename__ = 'solutions'

    id = db.Column(db.Integer, primary_key=True)
    user_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('users.id'), nullable=False)
    problem_id = db.Column(db.Integer, db.ForeignKey('problems.id'), nullable=False)
    submission_code = db.Column(db.Text, nullable=False)
    submission_date = db.Column(db.DateTime, nullable=False, default=db.func.current_timestamp())
    status = db.Column(db.String(50), nullable=False)
    execution_time = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=True)
    memory_used = db.Column(db.Float, nullable=True)

    # Relationships
    user = db.relationship('User', backref=db.backref('solutions', lazy=True))
    problem = db.relationship('Problem', backref=db.backref('solutions', lazy=True))
files.purpose: Define the Solution model for storing user submissions.

from flask import Flask
from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_blueprint
from app.controllers.user_controller import user_blueprint
from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_blueprint

def register_routes(app: Flask):
    """
    Aggregate all blueprints and define the API routes.
    This function registers all the routes for the application.
    """
    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint()), url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint()), url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint()), url_prefix='/solutions')

from flask import Flask
from app.routes import *
from app.database import db

def create_app():
    app = Flask(__name__)

    # Configure the app (e.g., database URI, debug settings, etc.)
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_DATABASE_URI'] = 'sqlite:///app.db'
    app.config['SQLALCHEMY_TRACK_MODIFICATIONS'] = False

    # Initialize database
    db.init_app(app)

    # Register blueprints
    from app.controllers.problem_controller import problem_blueprint
    from app.controllers.user_controller import user_blueprint
    from app.controllers.solution_controller import solution_blueprint

    app.register_blueprint(problem_blueprint()), url_prefix='/problems')
    app.register_blueprint(user_blueprint()), url_prefix='/users')
    app.register_blueprint(solution_blueprint()), url_prefix='/solutions')

    return app

readme_content:
# ACM Problem-Solving Platform

A website designed to help users solve ACM-style programming problems and improve their coding skills.

## Features

- Problem Library: A comprehensive library of ACM-style programming problems categorized by difficulty and topic.
- Code Submission and Evaluation: Allows users to submit code solutions and receive automated feedback on correctness and performance.
- User Profiles and Progress Tracking: Enables users to create profiles, track their progress, and view their problem-solving history.
- Leaderboard: Displays rankings of users based on their problem-solving performance and achievements.
- Hints and Tutorials: Provides hints and tutorials to help users understand problem-solving techniques and algorithms.

## Setup

```bash
pip install -r requirements.txt
python app.py
```

## Usage

Open http://localhost:5000 in your browser.
